- [IDAT.1.7] **`const char *` strings are caller-owned unless
  stated otherwise.** libds does not copy string
  arguments defensively; callers keep ownership for
  the lifetime documented per-function. For strings
  libds returns in result structs, libds owns the
  pointer and guarantees stability for a documented
  lifetime (usually "until the next call on this
  engine").

---
